metadata.agent_last_message:
- Implemented the RS274/NGC G-code simulator in Node.js (no deps), including final-state JSON output + optional stepped motion trace per the prompt/spec (`output/simulator.js:553`).
- Runnable as `node main.js ...` via a tiny wrapper (`main.js:1`) that dispatches to the required entrypoint (`output/main.js:1`).
- Parser/enforcement includes RS274 line rules like max 4 M-words/line (`output/gcode_parser.js:62`), inverse-time G93 requires `F` on every G1/G2/G3 motion line, and multi-submotion inverse-time duration apportioning (`output/simulator.js:553`).
- Trace/output serialization follows the delta/snapshot rules; coordinate system offsets are reported in machine coordinates including active G92 offsets (`output/machine_state.js:208`).

Run example:
`node main.js --input program.ngc --output out.json --trace-output trace.json --trace-time-step 0.01`
